parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a retractable pen, made of plastic, located at the top of the pen. It is small and cylindrical.
parts.Functional_description: The button is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, engaging the internal spring mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically along the pen’s axis when pressed and released, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, forming the cylindrical structure that houses the ink cartridge.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, holds the ink refill, and serves as the main gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the fixed part of the pen while other components like the button and tip move.
